name: spatial_graph
description: Inspect native Linux desktop spatial UI scene graph (AT-SPI2 accessibility + DRM framebuffer fusion) and execute deterministic clicks, input, and widget interactions without slow vision models.

action.description: Action to perform: 'inspect' to dump UI scene graph, 'find' to locate widget, 'click' to click, 'type' to input text.

target.description: Target widget label, name, ID, or ref for click or type.

text.description: Text content to inject when action is 'type'.

role.description: Optional widget role filter (button, text, entry, combo-box, tab).

hardware.description: Set to true to force physical synthetic HID input via uinput/XTest.
